# Dnaso

> Dnaso publishes plain-English guides to home backup power in the United States: whole-house and portable generators, home battery backup, sizing, costs, installation and maintenance. Every guide is also published in Spanish.

Dnaso is an informational site (no products are sold). Guides state their sources, give cost and sizing figures as ranges from named references, and separate manufacturer claims from tested results. Author persona: Mike Donovan, home-power researcher.

## Core pages
